Prateek Maheshwari (40.31%){{cite news |last1=Sonavane |first1=Ravindra |title=PhysicsWallah founders Alakh Pandey and Prateek Boob join billionaire club ahead of IPO |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/physicswallah-founders-alakh-pandey-and-prateek-boob-join-billionaire-club-ahead-of-ipo-13655452.html |access-date=6 November 2025 |work=Moneycontrol |date=6 November 2025}} | subsidiaries = {{Unbulleted list| *FreeCo *Prep Online *Altis Vortex *iNeuron *Etoos India *PW Skills *PW School of Startups *Gyann-e *Physics Wallah Digital University *PW Institute of Innovation *PW OnlyIAS *PW Store *Xylem Learning *Acadfly *CuriousJr}} | website = {{URL|https://www.pw.live}} }} '''Physics Wallah Limited''' ('''PW''') is an Indian [[educational technology]] company headquartered in [[Noida]]. It was started by Alakh Pandey as a [[YouTube]] channel in 2016 and was aimed at teaching physics for the [[JEE]], [[National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate)|NEET]], and [[Central Board of Secondary Education|CBSE board]] examinations. As the channel began to gain more viewership, Pandey also started to post [[chemistry]] content. In 2020, Pandey, along with his co-founder, Prateek Maheshwari, established Physics Wallah as a [[company]]. Physics Wallah became a [[Unicorn (finance)|unicorn]] company in 2022.{{Cite web |date=2022-06-07 |title=PhysicsWallah Turns 101th Indian Unicorn With $100 Million Fundraise |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/news/physicswallah-turns-101th-indian-unicorn-with-100-million-fundraise-news-200854 |access-date=2025-04-10 |website=Outlook Business |language=en}} As of September 2024, the company was valued at around $2.8 billion.{{Cite web |last=Pratap |first=Anushree |title=Physics Wallah's valuation hits $2.8 billion, latest funding round brings $210 million |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/business/companies/physics-walla-s-valuation-hits-2-8-bn-latest-funding-round-brings-210-mn-3200038 |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Deccan Herald |language=en}} Physics Wallah [[went public]] on the Indian exchanges with a {{INRconvert|3480|c}} [[initial public offering]] (IPO) in November 2025.{{cite news |last1=Sethi |first1=Vaamanaa |title=PhysicsWallah shares make strong debut on Indian stock market, list at 33% premium |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/physicswallah-ipo-listing-shares-make-strong-debut-on-indian-stock-market-list-at-33-premium-11763439801931.html |access-date=19 January 2026 |work=mint |date=18 November 2025 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=PhysicsWallah shares make strong market debut, list at 33% premium over IPO price on NSE |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/physicswallah-share-price-stock-lists-at-33pc-premium-over-ipo-price-on-nse-13682021.html |access-date=19 January 2026 |work=Moneycontrol}} == History == Physics Wallah, was founded in 2016 as a YouTube channel hosted by Alakh Pandey, an educator hailing from [[Prayagraj]], [[Uttar Pradesh]]. The channel was initially focused on teaching the physics curriculum for the [[Joint Entrance Examination|Joint Entrance Examinations]] (JEE), a popular entrance examination in India.{{cite news |title=The Unicorn Youtuber: Alakh Pandey |url=https://www.entrepreneur.com/en-in/entrepreneurs/the-unicorn-youtuber-alakh-pandey/431140 |work=[[Entrepreneur (magazine)|Entrepreneur]] |language=en |date=11 July 2022}} Due to Pandey's style of teaching,{{Cite web |date=11 September 2023 |title=Here's how Physics Wallah solved the edtech riddle and is now aiming for growth |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/deep-dive/story/heres-how-physics-wallah-solved-the-edtech-riddle-and-is-now-aiming-for-growth-397870-2023-09-11 |access-date=2024-03-03 |website=Business Today |language=en}} the channel grew rapidly, reaching over 2 million followers in 2019.{{Cite web |title=Work, Force, Energy & PhysicsWallah: Meet 'Robinhood' Pandey, And His Freshly Minted Edtech Unicorn |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/take-one-big-story-of-the-day/work-force-energy-physicswallah-meet-robinhood-pandey-and-his-freshly-minted-edtech-unicorn/77017/1 |access-date=2024-03-03 |website=Forbes India |language=en}} In 2020, Pandey along with co-founder Prateek Maheshwari developed the Physics Wallah app. The app was initially designed for students aspiring to take the [[National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate)|National Eligibility cum Entrance Test]] (NEET) and [[Joint Entrance Examination|Joint Entrance Exam]] (JEE){{cite news |last1=Gupta |first1=Aryaman |date=7 December 2022 |title=PhysicsWallah, the unassuming underdog among ed-tech firms in India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/physicswallah-the-unassuming-underdog-among-edtech-firms-in-india-122120700919_1.html |newspaper=[[Business Standard]] |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Majumdar |first1=Debleena |title=What does it take to create Bharat's education lab: The story of PhysicsWallah, building on trust |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/prime/technology-and-startups/what-does-it-take-to-create-bharats-education-lab-the-story-of-physicswallah-building-on-trust/primearticleshow/95669148.cms Over the next few years, Physics Wallah expanded their offerings by launching courses for other competitive exams including but not limited to [[Union Public Service Commission]] (UPSC),{{Cite web |title=PW to revolutionize learning space for UPSC Aspirants launches UPSC Wallah |url=https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2022/11/10/del70-upsc-wallah.html |access-date=2023-04-08 |website=The Week |language=en}} [[International Science Olympiad|Olympiads]], and various non-competitive exams including [[Central Board of Secondary Education|CBSE]] and state boards, among others.{{fact|date=January 2026}} As of February 2025, the Physics Wallah app had been downloaded over 10 million times on the [[Google Play|Google Play Store]]. In September 2024, the company raised $210 million in funding at $2.8 billion valuation.{{Cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Digbijay |last2=Sharma |first2=Samidha |date=2024-09-20 |title=PhysicsWallah closes $210 million funding round led by Hornbill Capital valuing it at $2.8 billion |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/funding/physicswallah-closes-200-million-funding-round-led-by-hornbill-capital-valuing-it-at-2-8-billion/articleshow/113513997.cms |access-date=2024-09-21 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} == Controversies == === Allegations by teachers === In March 2023, several teachers at the ed-tech company alleged that the vision of the company was being disillusioned and in response started an independent [[YouTube]] channel by the name, 'Sankalp Bharat'.{{Cite web |title=All you need to know about Physics Wallah controversy as former teachers slam edtech giant in latest video |url=https://www.freepressjournal.in/education/watch-physics-wallah-controversy-know-why-ex-teachers-left-in-tears-on-camera |access-date=2023-03-29 |website=Free Press Journal |language=en}} Through a video uploaded on the same YouTube channel, they delved into the reasons behind their departure from Physics Wallah, citing the company's atmosphere as the primary factor. extract:
Physics Wallah Limited (PW) is an Indian educational technology company headquartered in Noida. It was started by Alakh Pandey as a YouTube channel in 2016 and was aimed at teaching physics for the JEE, NEET, and CBSE board examinations. As the channel began to gain more viewership, Pandey also started to post chemistry content. In 2020, Pandey, along with his co-founder, Prateek Maheshwari, established Physics Wallah as a company.
Physics Wallah became a unicorn company in 2022. As of September 2024, the company was valued at around $2.8 billion. Physics Wallah went public on the Indian exchanges with a ₹3,480 crore (US$360 million) initial public offering (IPO) in November 2025.
